BiblicalUsage: Fire slays the men who lift up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego toward the furnace, and Daniel is lifted up out of the lions' den unhurt.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that lifting goes both ways with God: the men who lift His servants toward the fire are consumed by it, and the servant who trusted Him is lifted out of the den.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
